(professional section) | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = John Bredal | league = [[Danish 2nd Division]] | season = [[2025–26 Danish 2nd Division|2025–26]] | position = Danish 2nd Division, 7th of 12 | website = {{URL|https://www.fremadamagerelite.dk/}} | pattern_la1 = _whiteborder | pattern_b1 = _3_stripes_vneck_white2 | pattern_ra1 = _whiteborder | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 1b47a5 | body1 = 1b47a5 | rightarm1 = 1b47a5 | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 1b47a5 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | owner = Lars Bax Sander Hein (via Salescorp Denmark ApS) }} '''Boldklubben Fremad Amager''' (meaning in [[English language|English]]: The Ball Club Forward Amager; abbreviated '''Fremad A''') is a Danish professional [[association football|football]] club based in the district of [[Amager Vest]], Copenhagen. The club's senior men's team play in [[Danish 2nd Division|2nd Division]], the third tier in the [[Danish football league system]]. The club have primarily played their home games at [[Sundby Idrætspark]] since the stadium's inauguration in 1922. Fremad Amager's last spell in the highest football league in Denmark was in the autumn of 1994. Ever since the first participation in the first nationwide league tournament in 1927, and subsequent promotion in 1929, the club has spent the majority of its history – with the exception of two seasons – in the different divisional structures (known as "''Danmarksturneringen i fodbold''"). The club reached the [[Danish Cup]] final in [[1971–72 Danish Cup|1971–72 season]] while playing at the second highest league level, but lost against [[Vejle Boldklub|Vejle BK]], who had also won the Danish championship in [[1971 Danish 1st Division|1971]]. As a result, BK Fremad Amager participated in the [[1972–73 European Cup Winners' Cup]], but did not advance beyond the first round. Described as a [[working class]] team, the [[Sundby, Copenhagen|Sundbyvester]]-based club has had long-standing rivalries against neighbouring clubs [[Boldklubben Frem|BK Frem]], [[Kastrup Boldklub|Kastrup BK]] and [[Boldklubben 1908|B 1908]]."}}
